examples.name: Sample — three identical child blocks
paragraphs: Section 2 prints Child’s Name / Address / City, State / Dates: From … To / Lived with / Relationship to Child three times over, with no heading on any of the three blocks. Each block is an anonymous group, read row by row; the blocks are separated by blank lines.
